bio: Keta Dvali is a Georgian figurative artist who completed the Certificate of Fine Arts program at the New York Academy of Art in 2025. Her work combines traditional academic training with a personal, evolving visual language. Her paintings Gazelle and Great Escape were featured in the Academy’s 2025 Certificate of Fine Arts Exhibition.
